result.description: Cloud helpdesk platform (QualityUnit) with ticketing, live chat, call center and knowledge base for customer support.
result.auth_detail: REST API v3 uses a per-account API key sent in `apikey` header. Keys generated by admin in account (Configuration > System > API). No OAuth for API v3; OAuth 2.1/bearer exists only for the built-in MCP server. Base URL is per-tenant (YOURDOMAIN.ladesk.com).
result.access_detail: No permanent free tier found on pricing page. Every plan starts with 30-day free trial, no card. Pricing page lists an API keys row on all plans (Starter 1, Team 5, Business 10, Enterprise unlimited), so API is on paid plans after trial. Signup is self-serve; per-tenant domain.
result.api_notes: REST API v3 with Swagger-style reference inside account (/docs/api/v3/); objects include agents, tickets, contacts, departments and more (full list not verified). Official Python client exists. Rate limits apply. Tickets list capped at 1000 rows per call (pagination needed).
result.blocker: API key auth only, per-tenant base URL (user must supply domain + key); no permanent free tier (30-day trial, then paid). Full endpoint docs gated behind login to an account.
